svg.text: MONSTER SHAPES: WHICH VIEW, AND HOW BIG
index = phase * 16 + party dir * 4 + monster orient. Sprite 1 to 4 pick a drawing, a negative number its mirror image; the attack shapes 5 and 6
replace the table value in the nearest row when the monster's attack frame byte is FEh or FFh.
Shape 1 is the front, 4 the back, 2 and
3 the side in two walk phases (looked
at in KOBOLD.CPS); 5 and 6 are attack

The result goes to a scratch block (gScratchBuf), so
